about: Tattoo designs Forge can add to a derived look, only on skin the finished outfit leaves visible (docs/BODY_ART_PLAN.md). Vector designs are paths authored in this repository (designs/*.json, Apache-2.0), rasterised by wardrobe/body_art/raster.py. A raster design (source: raster) is a PNG installed only by tools/body_art/install_design.py, with its licence and origin in designs/<id>.provenance.json beside it.

designs.name: Tribal Wings
designs.description: Symmetrical winged tribal across the shoulder blades, narrowing to the spine.

designs.name: Thorn Filigree
designs.description: A central diamond with thorned curls to each shoulder blade.

designs.name: V Tribal
designs.description: Two blades rising from low on the spine to each shoulder blade, barbed on their outer edge.

designs.name: Spine Tribal
designs.description: A tall central blade on the spine with flourishes curling out to each side.

designs.name: Geometric Bands
designs.description: Two curved bands over the shoulder blades with shark-teeth between them.

designs.name: Lace Ornament
designs.description: A rosette on the spine and scalloped arches to each side: soft, lace-like.

designs.name: Flame
designs.description: A single tribal flame on one shoulder blade.

designs.name: Spine Vine
designs.description: A stem with alternating leaves along the spine.

designs.name: Lotus Ornament
designs.description: A lotus at the centre of the lower back with flourishes to the sides.

designs.name: Crescent and Star
designs.description: A small crescent moon and star at the nape of the neck.
